#  read in prescribed and actual bed times
```{r}

library(here)

bed_times <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw", "SRT", "Prescribed Sleep Windows", "set_bed_times.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(
    rise_time_set = dmy_hm(rise_time_set),
    bed_time_set = dmy_hm(bed_time_set),
    rise_time_actual_SD = dmy_hm(rise_time_actual_SD),
    bed_time_actual_SD = dmy_hm(bed_time_actual_SD),
    bed_date_actual_actigraphy = dmy(bed_date_actual_actigraphy),
    rise_date_actual_actigraphy = dmy(rise_date_actual_actigraphy),
    bed_time_actual_actigraphy = as.POSIXct(paste(bed_date_actual_actigraphy, bed_time_actual_actigraphy)),
    rise_time_actual_actigraphy = as.POSIXct(paste(rise_date_actual_actigraphy, rise_time_actual_actigraphy))
  ) %>%
  select(-bed_date_actual_actigraphy, -rise_date_actual_actigraphy)

# Harmonize times & compute time differences
bed_times_after <- bed_times %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(bed_time_set, rise_time_set, bed_time_actual_SD, rise_time_actual_SD,
      bed_time_actual_actigraphy, rise_time_actual_actigraphy),
    ~ with_tz(force_tz(.x, "Europe/London"), "UTC")
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    time_difference_bedtime_sleepdiary = as.numeric(difftime(bed_time_actual_SD, bed_time_set, units = "mins")),
    time_difference_risetime_sleepdiary = as.numeric(difftime(rise_time_actual_SD, rise_time_set, units = "mins")),
    time_difference_bedtime_actigraphy = as.numeric(difftime(bed_time_actual_actigraphy, bed_time_set, units = "mins")),
    time_difference_risetime_actigraphy = as.numeric(difftime(rise_time_actual_actigraphy, rise_time_set, units = "mins"))
  )

# 3. Save processed data to root/Data/processed/SRT/
# We use here() to ensure dir.create and write_xlsx look at the root, not the script folder
processed_path <- here("Data", "processed", "SRT")

if (!dir.exists(processed_path)) {
  dir.create(processed_path, recursive = TRUE)
}

write_xlsx(bed_times_after, file.path(processed_path, "prescribed_and_actual_bed_times.xlsx"))
```

# Compute adherence scores
```{r}
# Sleep Diary Adherence
sleepdiary_adherence_data <- bed_times_after %>%
  mutate(
    adherent_bedtime_sleepdiary = if_else(time_difference_bedtime_sleepdiary < -15, 0, 1),
    adherent_risetime_sleepdiary = if_else(abs(time_difference_risetime_sleepdiary) > 15, 0, 1),
    daily_adherence_score_SD = adherent_bedtime_sleepdiary + adherent_risetime_sleepdiary
  )

# Actigraphy Adherence
actigraphy_adherence_data <- bed_times_after %>%
  mutate(
    adherent_bedtime_actigraphy = if_else(time_difference_bedtime_actigraphy < -15, 0, 1),
    adherent_risetime_actigraphy = if_else(abs(time_difference_risetime_actigraphy) > 15, 0, 1),
    daily_adherence_score_act = adherent_bedtime_actigraphy + adherent_risetime_actigraphy
  )

# Combine Methods
adherence_summary_df <- sleepdiary_adherence_data %>%
  left_join(
    select(actigraphy_adherence_data, id, day,
           adherent_bedtime_actigraphy, adherent_risetime_actigraphy, daily_adherence_score_act),
    by = c("id", "day")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    both_methods_adherent = if_else(daily_adherence_score_SD == 2 & daily_adherence_score_act == 2, 1, 0)
  )
```


```{r}
completeness_summary <- bed_times_after %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_days = n(),
    complete_days_SD = sum(!is.na(bed_time_actual_SD) & !is.na(rise_time_actual_SD)),
    completeness_rate_SD = complete_days_SD / total_days,
    incomplete_diary = completeness_rate_SD < 0.5,
    complete_days_act = sum(!is.na(bed_time_actual_actigraphy) & !is.na(rise_time_actual_actigraphy)),
    completeness_rate_act = complete_days_act / total_days,
    incomplete_actigraphy = completeness_rate_act < 0.5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(completeness_summary, caption = "Participant Data Completeness")
```
# Plot A
```{r}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(hms)
library(scales)
library(ggprism)

# 1. Read Data
actigraphy_data <- read_csv(here("Data", "processed", "actigraphy", "actigraphy_data_clean.csv"))


# 1. Process Data
sleep_processed <- actigraphy_data %>%
  mutate(
    fell_asleep_hms = as_hms(`Fell asleep`),
    woke_up_hms = as_hms(`Woke up`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fell_asleep_hms), !is.na(woke_up_hms)) %>%
  # Handle midnight wrap-around (18:00 threshold)
  mutate(
    bed_sec  = as.numeric(fell_asleep_hms),
    wake_sec = as.numeric(woke_up_hms),
    bed_sec  = ifelse(bed_sec < 18*3600, bed_sec + 86400, bed_sec),
    wake_sec = ifelse(wake_sec < 18*3600, wake_sec + 86400, wake_sec)
  )

# 2. Summarize by Week
sleep_summary <- sleep_processed %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(
    across(c(bed_sec, wake_sec), list(
      med  = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
      low  = ~quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
      high = ~quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    ))
  ) %>%
  # FIX: Automatically find and sort whatever labels are in the 'Week' column
  mutate(
    Week = as.character(Week),
    # Sorts numerically so "Week 2" comes before "Week 10"
    all_weeks = str_sort(unique(Week), numeric = TRUE),
    # Ensure "Baseline" is always the first level
    Week = factor(Week, levels = c("Baseline", setdiff(all_weeks, "Baseline")))
  )

# 3. Convert for ggplot
sleep_summary <- sleep_summary %>%
  mutate(across(contains("_sec_"), 
                ~as.POSIXct(.x, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
                .names = "{.col}_dt"))

# 4. Define Plot A (No Grids)
plot_A <- ggplot(sleep_summary, aes(y = Week)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = bed_sec_low_dt, xmax = bed_sec_high_dt), 
                 linewidth = 8, color = "#7a5195", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = wake_sec_low_dt, xmax = wake_sec_high_dt), 
                 linewidth = 8, color = "#7a5195", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = bed_sec_med_dt, xmax = wake_sec_med_dt), 
                 linewidth = 8, color = "#003f5c") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(sleep_summary$Week))) +
  scale_x_datetime(
    labels = date_format("%H:%M"), 
    breaks = date_breaks("2 hours"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Clock Time",
    y = "Study Week"
  )

# View result
plot_A
```
# plot B

```{r tib-comparison-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

# 1. Load Data Sources
# Note: Ensure TIB_prescribed and ECG_processed were created in previous steps
ECG_TIB_data <- read_csv(here("Data", "processed", "ECG", "TIB_ECG_data.csv"))


# Process ECG data to match the standard format
ECG_processed <- ECG_TIB_data %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Convert character strings to actual Date-Time objects
    start_dt = dmy_hm(Start),
    end_dt   = dmy_hm(End),
    
    # 2. Calculate the difference in hours
    TIB = as.numeric(difftime(end_dt, start_dt, units = "hours")),
    
    # 3. Standardize column names for the join
    id = as.character(ParticipantID),
    week = case_when(
      Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "BSL",
      Timepoint == "Int"      ~ "1", # Adjust "1" if "Int" refers to a different week
      TRUE ~ as.character(Timepoint)
    ),
    method = "ECG"
  ) %>%
  select(id, week, TIB, method)

# 1. Load the pre-existing EEG summary file 
# Ensure you are using read_excel from the readxl library
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

eeg_clean <- read_excel(here("Data", "processed", "EEG", "clean_EEG_data.xlsx"))

# 2. Process EEG data for the plot (Using explicit dplyr functions to avoid errors)
EEG_processed <- eeg_clean %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Handle the numeric conversion for TIB
    TIB = as.numeric(`TIB (mins)`) / 60, 
    # Use as.integer then as.character to strip any decimals from IDs (e.g., 2.0 -> "2")
    id  = as.character(as.integer(Real_ID)), 
    week = case_when(
      Timepoint == "BSL" ~ "BSL",
      Timepoint == "SRT" ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Timepoint)
    ),
    method = "EEG"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, week, TIB, method)

# 3. Create TIB_prescribed (Excluding ECG)

    TIB = as.numeric(difftime(rise_time_set, bed_time_set, units = "hours")),

# 4. Combine Raw Data (EXCLUDING ECG)
TIB_raw_combined <- bind_rows(
  TIB_prescribed %>% dplyr::mutate(id = as.character(id)),
  EEG_processed  %>% dplyr::mutate(id = as.character(id))
)
```

# Plot C & D
```{r}
# Pivot for visualization
adherence_long <- adherence_summary_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("time_difference"),
    names_to = c("time_of_day", "method"),
    names_pattern = "time_difference_(.*)_(.*)",
    values_to = "time_difference"
  ) %>%
  filter(time_difference <= 300) %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method, "sleepdiary" = "Sleep Diary", "actigraphy" = "Actigraphy"))

# 1. Prepare Plot B
plot_C <- ggplot(adherence_long, aes(x = week, y = time_difference, color = time_of_day)) +
  # Error bars and Mean points
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = time_of_day)) +
  
  # Reference Lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-15, 15), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Faceting
  facet_wrap(~method) +
  
  # Scales & Legend Formatting
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#003f5c", "#bc5090"),
    labels = c("bedtime" = "Bedtime", "risetime" = "Risetime") # Capitalize labels
  ) +
  
  # Theme Customization
  theme_bw() + # Start with a stable base
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove grids
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),     # Remove box
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(), # Clean facet labels
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.title = element_blank(),     # Remove legend title
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    y = "Difference from Prescribed Time (Mins)", 
    x = "Week"
  )

# To view it:
 plot_C
 
 # 1. Prepare Plot D (Daily Adherence)
plot_D <- ggplot(adherence_long, aes(x = day, y = time_difference, color = time_of_day)) +
  # Use stat_summary to get the mean/SE for each specific day
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = time_of_day), linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Reference Lines (0, +/- 15 mins)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-15, 15), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Faceting by Method
  facet_wrap(~method) +
  
  # Scales & Legend
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#003f5c", "#bc5090"),
    labels = c("bedtime" = "Bedtime", "risetime" = "Risetime")
  ) +
  # Adjust x-axis breaks based on your study length (e.g., every 5 days)
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(adherence_long$day, na.rm = TRUE), by = 5)) +
  
  # Theme Customization (Matching your no-grid style)
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom", # Moved to bottom to save horizontal space
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    y = "Difference from Prescribed Time (Mins)", 
    x = "Study Day"
  )


plot_D
 
```

# Combine Plots
```{r, fig.width=17, fig.height=10}
library(patchwork)

# 1. Standardize Theme & Legend Positions for 2x2 Layout
# Moving all legends to the bottom helps maintain a consistent plotting area width
plot_A_final <- plot_A + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5,5,5,5))
plot_B_final <- plot_B + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5,5,5,5))
plot_C_final <- plot_C + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5,5,5,5))
plot_D_final <- plot_D + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5,5,5,5))

# 2. Combine into 2x2 Grid
# (A + B) creates the top row
# (C + D) creates the bottom row
# ncol = 2 forces the two-column structure
final_quad_plot <- (plot_A_final + plot_B_final) / (plot_C_final + plot_D_final) + 
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = 'A'
  )

# To view in your IDE:
 final_quad_plot
 
 # 1. Create the directory if it doesn't exist yet (Safety Step)
if (!dir.exists(here("Figures", "Adherence"))) {
  dir.create(here("Figures", "Adherence"), recursive = TRUE)
}

# 2. Save the Final Quad Plot to the specific folder
ggsave(
  filename = here("Figures", "Adherence", "Figure S1.jpg"), 
  plot = final_quad_plot,
  width = 17, 
  height = 11, 
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("Figures", "Adherence", "Figure S1.tiff"), 
  plot = final_quad_plot,
  width = 17, 
  height = 11, 
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)

# 3. Print confirmation of the exact path
cat("File successfully saved to:", here("Output", "adherence", "Figure S1.jpg"))
```
